On the training data the rule "389 is on if and only if a4:1 or a5:1" fails on 0 of the 345 rows. The a5:4 term (0.21 per sd) nudges 389 up a little when a4:1 holds; without a4:1 its pre-activation at a5:4 is -0.25, below zero, so 389 stays off. The a4:2 branch (unit 2443, 0.48 per sd into it, -0.0006 from it into 389) never fires: its pre-activation is at most -0.28 over the a4 levels, and it is positive on 0 training rows.
